The list_refunds tool result matches the refunds reported by Alpha Co. Now that the refunds are verified, I need to list all orders to determine which customers need payouts and then calculate the net balance for each using net_balance(customer). I will start by listing all orders.

I have the list of orders and they cover three customers: 'acme', 'birch', and 'cobalt'. The next step is to get the net balance for each of these customers using the net_balance tool. I will start with 'acme'.
I have the net balance for 'acme'. Next, I will get the net balance for 'birch'.
I have the net balance for 'birch'. Finally, I will get the net balance for 'cobalt'.

The payout for 'acme' was recorded successfully. Next, I will record the payout for 'birch' with an amount of 34692 cents.
